description: Publish an app to Qumge on the developer's behalf (needs the developer's Qumge key in the Authorization header). Give it a name, the app's HTTPS base_url, and — if you can read them off the app — its price book (events with a unit price) and routes (with a per-call ceiling). It returns a DRAFT app plus the signing secret and usage key (shown once). Nothing is charged while it is a draft. There is no human review: after test_app passes, submit_app_review takes the app live immediately, and qumge spot-checks it afterwards (a spot check can suspend it).

balance_json_path.description: Only for balance_delta: where in that response.

balance_path.description: Only for balance_delta: where we read the balance.

base_url.description: Where the app lives. Must be https.

events.description: Price book events. unit_price_usd is in US dollars, e.g. 0.10.

keywords.description: Other names for the same thing, any language, up to 20. Agents search with a request like "scrape trending TikTok videos" — the keywords are what makes that find this app.

metering.description: reported (the app tells us what to charge) or balance_delta (we read its balance).

name.description: Human name shown in the store.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

refund_policy_url.description: Their refund policy, if they have one.

routes.description: HTTP routes. Billable routes need hold_usd (the most one call may cost).

lane.description: standard (default: one ledger row per call) or micro — for routes priced below $0.001. A micro route must settle on_response, its per-call ceiling must be at most $0.01, and calls settle in per-minute buckets instead of one row each.

rate_limit_per_min.description: Micro lanes only: calls per minute per key (default 600).

skill_slug.description: Optional. Attach an existing skill from the catalog to this app (its documentation then shows on the app page). Ignored if the slug is unknown.

slug.description: Optional URL slug. Derived from the name when omitted.

social_links.description: Up to 6 public URLs for the developer (X, GitHub, LinkedIn, their website). Shown on every app page. The kind is guessed from the domain.

summary.description: One line describing what it does.

support_url.description: Where users ask for help. Shown on the app page.

name: publish_app
